title: Remove final LLM, adoption, and direct-runtime REST mutation endpoints
intent: Complete the REST deprecation plan by removing remaining REST mutation routes that duplicate signer-first Nostr reactor handlers for LLM route/release creation, adoption scan/import, and direct runtime deploy/restart/stop.
observed_behavior_before: router.go mounted POST /llm/routes and POST /llm/routes/{routeId}/releases when an LLM registry dependency existed.
router.go mounted POST /adoption/scan and POST /adoption/import when adoption.enabled was true.
router.go mounted POST /services/{serviceId}/environments/{envId}/deploy|restart|stop when direct_runtime_actions.enabled was true.
pkg/client still issued HTTP POST calls for adoption scan/import and direct-runtime deploy/restart/stop.
intended_behavior_after: The seven REST mutation route registrations are not mounted under /api/v1.
The corresponding exported HTTP handler methods are deleted from llm.go, adoption.go, and service_actions.go without deleting the files/types used elsewhere.
LLM read routes and PUT /llm/routes/{id} remain mounted when an LLM registry is configured.
Client helpers for the removed REST mutations fail before network access with Nostr signer-first guidance.
Docs and the REST deprecation checklist identify signer-first Nostr events as the supported replacement.
out_of_scope: Deleting LLM read routes or PUT /llm/routes/{id}.
Deleting whole handler files or domain/client DTO types.
